title: On a Stationarity Theory for Stochastic Volterra Integral Equations with Affine Drift
abstract: arXiv:2511.03474v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper investigate the properties of solutions to forward Stochastic Volterra Integral Equations (SVIEs for short) with affine drift, specifically their stationarity, both over a finite horizon and in the long run. We demonstrate that it is possible to induce a $\textit{fake stationary regime}$, in the sense that all marginal distributions share the same expectation and variance. translated_title: 关于具有仿射漂移的随机Volterra积分方程的平稳性理论
translated_abstract: 本文研究了具有仿射漂移的前向随机Volterra积分方程（简称SVIEs）解的性质，特别是其在有限时间区间和长期意义上的平稳性。我们证明可以诱导出一种“伪平稳状态”，即所有边缘分布具有相同的期望和方差。这种现象可以通过对漂移项中出现的确定性初始条件 φ 和均值回归函数 μ 进行显式闭式设定来实现，或者通过在扩散系数中引入一个与核相关联的确定性稳定因子 ς 来实现，同时保持函数 μ 在其他方面完全灵活。我们进一步研究了当时间趋于无穷时此类过程的 L^p-汇聚性质（p>0），即我们考察与不同（原文在此处截断）……相关的解的边缘分布是否……的极限行为。
tldr: 该论文提出了具有仿射漂移的随机Volterra积分方程的平稳性理论，证明通过显式设定初始条件与均值回归函数、或在扩散系数中引入确定性稳定因子，可以诱导出所有边缘分布期望和方差相同的“伪平稳状态”，并研究了此类过程随时间趋于无穷的L^p-汇聚性质。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a stationarity theory for stochastic Volterra integral equations with affine drift, showing that a "fake stationary regime"—where all marginal distributions share the same mean and variance—can be induced either by explicit closed-form specifications of the initial condition and mean-reversion function or by a deterministic stabilizing factor in the diffusion coefficient, and further studies the L^p-confluence of such processes as time tends to infinity.
